snippet.title: Drill Rift - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Drill Rift is a new turn-based strategy game from Steam Veil Games. 

Upgrade your drilling machinery and level up your dwarves for better chances of success. Balance resource management, strategic upgrades and the mental toll of the rift. As the deeper you dig, the louder the whispers become. 

Drill Rift will launch on PC (Steam) in Q4 of 2025.

#Gametrailers #DrillRift #Turnbased
